name: Reparameterized Stochastic Gradient Descent
aliases: Reparameterized Stochastic Gradient Descent for Parameter Optimization
definition: An optimization technique to find altered scattering parameters (g, σₛ) that minimize an error function d(g, σₛ) between a rendered image and a target image, using a reparameterized search space to avoid local minima.
summary: Reparameterized Stochastic Gradient Descent optimizes scattering parameters by transforming the search space to regularize the error surface and using sequential 1D searches to escape local minima.
